notes.title: Post Next Fest - An Update on logik
notes.content:
[b][h3]Hello All![/h3][/b]

You may know this past week was Steam's Summer Next Fest, and logik was in it!

I would like to say that it was a huge success for logik! Thank you for all of the support and wishlists for my upcoming game, logik! It's my first commercial release on Steam and the number of wishlists was increased dramatically!

Thank you [b]so very much[/b] for all of the support and wishlisting of my game! ːsteamthumbsupː

Keep being awesome, and I will start to update my progress in making logik as announcements on the steam community.

- thisGameDev
